style_bible.palette: sodium amber and ash grey against deep teal-black; one warm paper white; firelight only where fire is present
style_bible.lighting: one hard practical per scene, negative fill, visible darkness; corridor cold, 4A warm, hotel blue, final frame firelit from one side
style_bible.lens: 24mm for wides and overheads, 50mm for mediums, 100mm macro for print and hands; shallow focus, subtle halation
style_bible.grain: fine 16mm grain, gentle contrast, blacks that keep texture; no digital clarity sheen
style_bible.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, cartoon, anime, oversaturated, stock-photo smile, modern social UI, fisheye, duplicate faces, floating objects, illegible gibberish text

music.mood: low cello pulse, tape hiss, a single piano note that stops when the name changes; no percussion until the smoke

scenes.narration: Tomorrow's paper had an obituary. Elias Voss. Apartment 4B. Fire. 3:07 a.m. He was alive.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on a folded broadsheet: tomorrow's date and a short obituary box dominate the frame. At the edges, living ink-stained fingers hold the paper; behind it, Elias's unshaven face is a dark shape. The page is the only bright object in the room. The camera begins on the name and pulls back just enough to reveal the living hands.
characters: Elias Voss - 34, gaunt, dark wool coat, close-cropped hair, ink-stained fingers, sleepless
scenes.environment: Kitchen table in apartment 4B, predawn; cold coffee ring, unopened mail, one bare bulb, rain on the window
scenes.lighting: Hard overhead bulb; the newspaper is overexposed, the room falls to black at the edges; no fill on Elias's face
scenes.camera: 100mm macro, top-down; slow pull-back from the obituary type to the hands and the dark shape of his face, 9:16
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 macro still, tomorrow's newspaper on a dark kitchen table, a short obituary column under a hard bare bulb, living ink-stained fingers holding the page, a gaunt man's face half-hidden behind it, cold coffee ring, rain-streaked window, teal shadows, sodium amber light, 100mm lens, shallow focus, fine 16mm grain, no legible body text

scenes.narration: He had no subscription. The fine print said: one name per fire.
scenes.visual: Wide low-angle of the apartment corridor. Elias stands small at the far end, newspaper under one arm, facing 4A. Every other door is shut. The stairwell light pulses, and the corridor's perspective lines converge on him.
characters: Elias Voss - far end of corridor, back to camera, newspaper under left arm
scenes.environment: Narrow 1970s corridor, mustard wallpaper, worn carpet, four closed doors, one caged stairwell bulb
scenes.lighting: Hard sodium light from the stairwell; long shadows stretch toward camera; 4A's door is the only warm rectangle
scenes.camera: 24mm wide, low angle, slow dolly forward down the corridor, one-point perspective, 9:16
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 wide still, low-angle 1970s apartment corridor at night, a small man at the far end holding a newspaper, mustard wallpaper, four closed doors, one caged sodium bulb, deep teal shadows, strong one-point perspective, 24mm lens, fine 16mm grain, no people in foreground, no legible text

scenes.narration: At 2:40, he knocked on 4A. His neighbour's heater. The one she'd asked him to fix.
scenes.visual: Over Elias's shoulder at 4A. The door opens a hand's width; Mara Kwan, sixties, stands in a warm slice of light. Behind her, a coil heater glows orange beside a curtain. Elias's knuckles are still raised in the foreground.
characters: Elias Voss - foreground shoulder and raised hand, coat collar up
Mara Kwan - 60s, cardigan, reading glasses pushed into grey hair, tired but alert
scenes.environment: 4A doorway; warm cluttered flat beyond, coil heater and thin curtain visible, hallway cold behind Elias
scenes.lighting: Warm interior spill against cold corridor; the heater element is the hottest point in frame; Mara's face is half-lit
scenes.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder, doorframe splits the frame, slow push toward the heater, 9:16
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 still, over-the-shoulder at an apartment door, a gaunt man's raised knuckles in foreground, a woman in her sixties in a warm slice of doorway light, a glowing coil heater and thin curtain behind her, cold teal corridor, sodium amber interior, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, fine 16mm grain, no legible text

scenes.narration: She said the super would come.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Mara's hand resting on the heater dial, then her face in the background, unconvinced. The dial is turned to maximum; a red indicator glows. Her hand is old, steady, and too close to the element.
characters: Mara Kwan - hand on dial in foreground, face soft in background
scenes.environment: 4A interior, coil heater close to a thin curtain, floral wallpaper, stack of unopened letters
scenes.lighting: Orange element underlight; Mara's face in half-shadow; the red dial is the only saturated colour
scenes.camera: 100mm macro, rack focus from the dial to her eyes, slight handheld drift, 9:16

scenes.narration: Elias took the stairs. He did not look back.
scenes.visual: Wide low-angle stairwell. Elias descends, one hand on the rail, coat billowing; his shadow climbs the wall behind him. The corridor door is a bright rectangle above him, already out of reach.
characters: Elias Voss - centered low on the stairs, back to camera, one hand on rail
scenes.environment: Concrete stairwell, peeling paint, caged bulb, metal handrail, dark landing below
scenes.lighting: Single caged bulb above; hard vertical shadows; cold blue below, warm sodium above
scenes.camera: 24mm wide, low angle, slow tilt down, strong verticals, 9:16

scenes.narration: From the hotel, he watched the smoke. At 3:07, 4B burned.
scenes.visual: Hotel window at night. Elias stands at the left edge, silhouetted; his reflection overlaps the city. Far right, a thin column of smoke rises from his building, lit amber at the base. The window frame traps him between his reflection and the fire.
characters: Elias Voss - left third, back to camera, silhouette and reflection
scenes.environment: Cheap hotel room, rain-streaked window, city lights below, his building visible across the rooftops
scenes.lighting: Blue room, amber smoke glow outside, no overhead light; reflection doubles his outline
scenes.camera: 35mm, frame-within-frame, slow push-in toward the smoke, 9:16

scenes.narration: The next paper waited at the desk.
scenes.visual: High-angle close-up of the hotel front desk. A fresh broadsheet sits beside a brass bell and a room key. The clerk's hand withdraws from frame. The paper is folded to the obituary page.
characters: Hotel clerk - hand only, withdrawing from frame
scenes.environment: Hotel reception, laminate counter, brass bell, key cubbies, wet glass ring
scenes.lighting: Single desk lamp, hard pool of light; background dark; paper is the brightest object

scenes.narration: Same fire. Same hour. Different name. Mara Kwan. Apartment 4A. Smoke.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of the new obituary. Elias's thumb presses beside the name MARA KWAN; a line of ash crosses the date. The paper is damp and puckered. The name is the only sharp thing in frame.
characters: Elias Voss - thumb and cuff only
scenes.environment: Hotel desk, lamplight, wet glass ring, a line of ash on the paper
scenes.lighting: Hard raking lamp from left; paper texture and ash highlighted; right side falls to black
scenes.camera: 100mm macro, slight handheld drift, rack focus across the name, 9:16

scenes.narration: She had gone in to warn him. Elias spread the editions across the floor. Every one had taken a name.
scenes.visual: Overhead shot of Elias's apartment floor. Dozens of editions radiate from him like a clock face; each front page has one obituary box circled in red. Elias kneels at the center, small, surrounded by paper. The composition is a broken mandala, not a grid.
characters: Elias Voss - kneeling at center, sleeves rolled, hands ink-stained, face lowered
scenes.environment: 4B floor, bare boards, overturned lamp, ash, rain at the window
scenes.lighting: Single lamp on the floor; hard radial pool; black edges; red pencil marks catch the light
scenes.camera: 24mm top-down, locked overhead, slow zoom out to reveal the full spread, 9:16

scenes.narration: The paper wasn't predicting the future. It was choosing who paid for it.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Elias's face, right third, lit from the left by the burning building through the window. A blank newspaper fills the lower foreground. He looks directly at camera for the first time. The low-opacity wordmark sits in the top margin; there is no end card and no logo intro.
characters: Elias Voss - close-up, soot on cheek, no expression left to read
scenes.environment: 4B window, smoke outside, blank newspaper in lap, ember light on the glass
scenes.lighting: Firelight key from the left, deep black on the right, ember flicker; the paper catches a thin rim
scenes.camera: 85mm close-up, very slow push-in, focus on the eyes, 9:16
